## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: VXX falling (VXX (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -15.21%) BELOW TREND) signals lower fear while Credit Spread ticked up (Credit Spread: 0.7336 | 1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.06% → flat ABOVE TREND) and HYG/LQD dynamics show rising credit stress, producing mixed signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing via VXX (VXX (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -15.21%) BELOW TREND) while credit metrics show stress rising (HYG (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +0.36%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND) and reflation pressure from commodities (CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +10.79%) ABOVE TREND) is boosting cyclicals.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: Dollar strength rising (Dollar Strength: +0.58% 1W | +1.86% 1M → flat ABOVE TREND) with stocks vs bonds flat-to-positive (SPY/TLT (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +3.30%) → flat ABOVE TREND), leaving conditions balanced but watch credit spread moves.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading but narrow: XLK (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.09%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +33.25%) ABOVE TREND are top performers while Financials show weakness (Financials sector: 1W: -1.51% | 1M: -1.81%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength but breadth is thin.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger with SPY (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND; EM/EEM (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND also showing leadership. Europe in CORRECTION (VGK (1W: -1.59% | 1M: +2.79%) CORRECTION) and China in RECOVERY (FXI (1W: +0.62% | 1M: -2.76%) RECOVERY).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Weakening: IBIT (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -18.50%) BELOW TREND and ETH-related ETFs (ETHA (1W: -12.30% | 1M: -23.58%) BELOW TREND) show heavy drawdown, IWM in CORRECTION (IWM (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +3.52%) CORRECTION) signals small-cap caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +10.79%) ABOVE TREND and broad industrial metals strength support reflation, while gold GLD (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -1.65%) BELOW TREND is soft.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed-positive: XLE (1W: +3.02% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +5.48% | 1M: -10.29%) RECOVERY, natural gas UNG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND remain sources of upside.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership — XLK (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.09%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +33.25%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Narrow breadth (3/11) plus rising credit spread/HYG-LQD tension and multiple correction flags (e.g., TAN, IWM, VGK) warrant caution.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech/semis (XLK, SOXX) and select reflation trades (CPER, UNG) while reducing exposure to defensive utilities XLU (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND and speculative crypto ETFs (IBIT). Monitor credit spreads and VIX/VXX for regime tilt.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.09%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +33.25%) ABOVE TREND; Materials/Miners via XME/CPER theme (CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +10.79%) ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples (sector: 1W: -3.99% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND; Crypto IBIT (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -18.50%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +10.79%) ABOVE TREND; UNG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: GLD (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -1.65%) BELOW TREND; WEAT (1W: -4.59% | 1M: -6.32%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX ~24.3 (VIX (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -13.40%) ↓ falling) for complacency pivot; Credit Spread ~0.7336 (Credit Spread: 0.7336 | 1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.06% → flat ABOVE TREND); Tech vs Financials ratio 3.8575 (↑ rising ABOVE TREND) as leadership gauge.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive with mixed risk signals (VXX falling vs rising credit stress). Tech/semis showing strength — XLK (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.09%) ABOVE TREND — while narrow breadth and credit spread moves are the key divergences to monitor.
